activity_summary: At the Cross the new wheat was six-and-thirty shillings the quarter, and you did not buy it. A woman at the sacks asked who was buying the barley, and for what. You had paid none, and you said so again. Joan kept the glove stall. You went toward the row with the children. Anne said she would meet you by the bakehouse.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard the price, kept the belt shut, and turned to the row.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the wheat, and went toward a ladder.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Sold at the glove stall, and would not make a speech of the rushes.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the gloves undescribed, and kept the board.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Sent you north, and set the bakehouse as the way back.

facets.activity: Heard the wheat at six-and-thirty shillings

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: The new wheat is six-and-thirty the quarter, and that is loud enough without me

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have paid none for barley

quotes.speaker: joan_shakespeare
quotes.text: The rushes for the house are already in
